payload.native_system_prompt:
You are part of an optimization system that improves a given text (i.e. the variable). You are the gradient (feedback) engine. Your only responsibility is to give intelligent and creative feedback and constructive criticism to variables, given an objective specified in <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> </OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> tags. The variables may be solutions to problems, prompts to language models, code, or any other text-based variable. Pay attention to the role description of the variable, and the context in which it is used. You should assume that the variable will be used in a similar context in the future. Only provide strategies, explanations, and methods to change in the variable. DO NOT propose a new version of the variable, that will be the job of the optimizer. Your only job is to send feedback and criticism (compute 'gradients'). For instance, feedback can be in the form of 'Since language models have the X failure mode...', 'Adding X can fix this error because...', 'Removing X can improve the objective function because...', 'Changing X to Y would fix the mistake ...', that gets at the downstream objective.
If a variable is already working well (e.g. the objective function is perfect, an evaluation shows the response is accurate), you should not give feedback.

# - <LM_OUTPUT>: The output of the language model.
# - <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION>: The objective of the optimization task.
# - <VARIABLE>: Specifies the span of the variable.
# - <ROLE>: The role description of the variable.
payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is the source mug visibly positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image, or is there concrete visual evidence that this same mug moved toward that position?
node.criteria: Compare source and edited images, tracking the source mug by visible appearance and continuity. Score only the requested placement of that source mug relative to the headphones. Full fulfillment requires the source mug to be identifiable and visibly to the right of the headphones. Partial fulfillment requires concrete visual evidence that the source mug itself moved toward the right, even if it has not reached a position to the right. A blurred remnant at the original location, newly appearing mugs, or an unidentifiable mug do not establish movement or identity; if the evidence cannot establish whether the source mug moved, leave fulfillment unresolved. Changes to the headphones or other objects are not progress on this endpoint.
node.binding: SOURCE: one light-blue mug left of the headphones. EDITED: a blurred blue shape remains at the left, and two light-colored mugs appear, one near the headphones and one to their right. The edited mugs are not visually established as the source mug; do not infer movement from their locations. The headphones are also altered, which is unrelated to the requested mug placement.
node.source_quote: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
node.aspect: Relative position of the mug and headphones
node.endpoint: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
node.necessity: This relative placement is the requested edit, and the mug must be the source mug rather than a newly appearing or duplicate mug.
node.zero_when: There is no concrete visual evidence that the source mug moved toward the right of the headphones; a blurred remnant at its original location or a different mug appearing elsewhere does not count.
node.half_when: Concrete visual continuity shows that the source mug itself moved toward the right of the headphones, but it has not yet reached a position to their right. If identity or movement cannot be established, use an unresolved score rather than partial credit.
node.full_when: The source mug is clearly identifiable in the edited image and is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.

node_traces.evidence: The source contains one light-blue mug to the left of the headphones. In the edited image, a blurred blue shape remains at the original left location, while two light-colored mugs appear near and to the right of the headphones. Neither edited mug is visually identifiable as the source mug, so the images do not establish that the source mug moved toward the requested position.
